'''Bitter vetch''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. They can be planted in all seasons, the leaves are edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]], and seeds when cooked.
 
Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] bitter vetch for its ''grain''.
